title: Oozing Syrian Lamb Tagine
description: Malty, springy lamb tagine with a tangy cranberry glaze, resting in fragrant spices for a bold, FODMAP‑friendly feast.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the lamb cubes and brown them on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the onion tops and garlic‑infused oil, cooking for another 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add cumin, coriander, cinnamon, paprika, salt, and pepper, stirring to coat the lamb and vegetables.
Pour in the cranberry juice and lemon juice, then add 200 ml of water; bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and let the tagine cook for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Check the lamb after 90 minutes; it should be fork‑tender and the sauce thickened.
Turn off the heat and let the lamb rest in the sauce for 10 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Just before serving, sprinkle chopped mint and parsley over the dish for a fresh finish.
Plate the lamb tagine over a bed of steamed rice or crusty bread, and enjoy the savory, malty aroma.
